map_benchmark holds four eight byte timing statistics for average map and map spread and average unmap and unmap spread followed by four byte thread count followed by four byte duration followed by signed four byte NUMA node followed by four byte address width followed by four byte direction followed by four byte transmit delay followed by four byte granule whose meaning depends on single versus scatter mode followed by one byte mode selector followed by seventy five spare bytes.

DMA_MAP_BENCHMARK triggers benchmarking through a read write control request identified by type code for lower case d with index one that carries the benchmark record in both directions.
uuid_le holds sixteen unsigned bytes with no padding or alignment gaps.
